question: Despite near-antiparallel target and P task-functional means, can a fixed binary native-factor subset isolate a stable target-specific residual across held-out v20 groups?
evidence_status: Post-v20 CPU diagnostic with even/odd group cross-fitting. A pass only nominates a factor subset for causal v21 confirmation; it is not causal identification.

searched: exact output-greedy, task-tangent, top-16 confirmation, v20 response tensor, and selectivity lower-bound receipts
all M11 hidden-mask, sparse-factor, greedy, response-basis, and construction-crossfit records
active board claims and canonical temporal dossier
prior_art.known_result: Pooled target/P native-factor response cosine is -.9816 and an unconstrained mean-cancellation relaxation needs 5.24x coefficient-norm amplification. That bound does not logically exclude a stable binary subset supported by the residual 19.1% direction.
prior_art.novelty: No prior test selects exact M11 factors with an explicit P penalty on one v20 group fold and evaluates unchanged binary prefixes on the opposite fold in both directions.

frozen_design.folds: Fit even group numbers and test odd, then fit odd and test even. Each fit/test fold contains eight matched rows per A1/A2/P/C panel.
frozen_design.score: On the fit fold, divide each factor's A1 and A2 mean contributions by the absolute corresponding full-factor panel mean. Divide its P mean contribution by pooled target full-effect RMS. Score factor n as min(A1_n,A2_n)-4*abs(P_n); sort descending with index as exact-tie breaker. Coefficients remain binary one.

predictions.pred_a_authority_shape_finiteness_folds_: Authorities, exact 4x16x4608 tensor, folds, score, stable ordering, finiteness, and CPU-only price pass.
predictions.pred_b_binary_top64_is_target_sufficient: On both held-out folds, top-64 reaches recovery >=.5, cosine >=.9, and direction >=.875 on A1/A2 while P/C normalized RMS are each <=.25.
predictions.pred_c_binary_factor_identity_is_crossfi: The two independently selected top-64 sets have Jaccard overlap >=.25.
predictions.pred_d_result_is_diagnostic_and_v21_rema: The result performs no model call or causal intervention and does not promote a v20-selected subset without v21 confirmation.

decision: B/C passing preserves a factor-splitting route and freezes a full-v20 order only for causal v21 testing. Any B or C miss closes fixed binary pruning as the immediate repair and prioritizes the queued native read/write sign localization.
